qa.what_happened: During the final lights-out period, the prisoners refused to comply despite the repeated warnings from the guards, leading to an early termination of the study.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 7526.

qa.what_happened: The study was stopped early due to our continuous refusal to comply with the guards' orders, even when they threatened to send us to the hole.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, refusing to comply and staying silent as per our agreement.

qa.what_happened: I gave the final warning before the study was prematurely halted. It's a tense situation with the prisoners refusing to comply and the other officers having escalated to threats.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me giving the final warning. The role has become increasingly taxing emotionally and ethically.

qa.what_happened: The refusal to comply escalated throughout the day, with the prisoners defiantly refusing my orders and asserting their desire to be heard. Despite the efforts of other officers, the situation remained unresolved until the study was prematurely terminated.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Officer Mercer, enforcing the rules as instructed.

qa.what_happened: The study ended early due to the ongoing defiance from the prisoners. Officers Avery and Holt had warned us repeatedly, but we continued to refuse until they decided to take action. I refused because I believed that our silence and compliance meant nothing without understanding the reasons behind our imprisonment.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I was Prisoner 1766 throughout the study, and I stood firm in my refusal.

qa.what_happened: Today, the prisoners refused to comply multiple times during meal and work details, and continued to insist on having their grievances heard before they would follow orders. When warnings failed, I had to escalate to threats of the hole, which I ultimately applied to Prisoner 7526 for his repeated defiance.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I had to maintain authority and enforce the rules despite the mounting tension and the prisoners' resistance.
